mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose from liver storage back into the blood was worthwhile because it showed what glycogen is for and where the glucose goes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the named portal vessel into its slot was straightforward but offered little to figure out.

surprise.text: I learned that the liver can store glucose as glycogen and release it between meals.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the named slot and pictures made the pairings clear, though the enzyme steps largely followed their labels.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting digestion to the rest of the body makes me curious how another system would fit in, even though some pairings were predictable.
